criterion: Maximize sum of score/max_score across the three equally weighted suite-budget cells; ties minimize summed actual token cost. No no-regression or zero-wrong-answer gate.
limits: Input integrity, complete accounting and frozen policies mandatory. No task-id or dataset-id routing.
recheck: One extra call on numeric literal after terse math prompt; denied/truncated correction retains original; unknown cost stops; repeated constant retains original.
limitations: Small author-generated selection sets; same novel tasks at two budgets are not independent samples. No hidden-test guarantee.
